answer: Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The garden holds work receipts rather than names, so the cipher of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, diluted when peers disagree, no identity may audit its own recruit. By the prism of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short.
